# Akehir.com

> Personal website of akehir — "CyberShaman by the Graces of Electron". Built with Angular and Tailwind CSS, featuring an interactive WebGL fluid simulation background, an integrated in-application command console, and PWA support.

## Sections

- [Home](https://akehir.com/): Landing page with interactive WebGL fluid animation
- [About](https://akehir.com/about): About the site owner
- [Blog](https://akehir.com/blog): Blog posts about self-hosting, LLMs, homelabs, Kubernetes, ChromeOS and more
- [Curriculum](https://akehir.com/curriculum): Curriculum vitae
- [Machina](https://akehir.com/machina): Interactive machine
- [Projects](https://akehir.com/projects): Overview of all projects
- [Colour Demo](https://akehir.com/demos/colour): Interactive colour drawing demo
- [Privacy](https://akehir.com/privacy): Privacy policy
- [Imprint](https://akehir.com/imprint): Imprint / legal notice

## Resources

- [Sitemap](https://akehir.com/assets/sitemap.xml): XML sitemap listing all pages
